# Evaluators

## Public checks

The six starter fixtures: each asks for one small, ordinary change and scores the result against the project's own checks (build, tests, lint, a reviewer's read). Three runs per fixture; the mean is the score.

## Held-out

The owner keeps a held-out set outside this checkout. Agents never see its path.
